name: A Big Wheel RV Park
note: Family-owned RV park (since 2006) under live oaks on Charlie Smith Sr Hwy north of St Marys, across from Crooked River State Park; call to reserve. 2026 daily full hookup $60 incl. tax; weekly and monthly rates too. RV Life 4.5*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: abigwheelrvpark.com live with rates and phone; RV Life 4.5* $$ over 147 reviews (price passes on the tier, gate 2026-10-01); Google 4.5 over 218; nightly sites (daily rate published)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 30.8373,-81.5645: RV rows among live oaks west of the highway; a small pond in the park's south corner is not at the rows and Crooked River is off-frame - not waterfront

name: Bear Branch RV Park
note: Small RV park on George L. Smith State Park Rd at Twin City, on a wooded cove of the park's cypress millpond (Google calls it Bear Branch RV Park & Wildlife). The old bearbranchrvpark.com no longer resolves. RV Life 5*/$$ (auto 10/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator domain dead; live presence by the Google rule (AWH 2026-10-01): place at the pin, not closed, phone 478-494-0094, 4.8 over 39 reviews; RV Life 5* $$ (price passes on the tier, gate 2026-10-01)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 32.54742,-82.12780: a few units at the head of a wooded cove of the George L. Smith millpond, under canopy; no pad confirmable at the water's edge - not waterfront (default down, low confidence: units appear within ~20 m of the cove)

name: Clay Hill Campground
note: Campground on a wooded peninsula on the Little River arm of J. Strom Thurmond (Clarks Hill) Lake, north of Lincolnton - USACE land run by Georgia Freshwater Campgrounds with Hester's Ferry. 10 water/electric 30A sites ($27) plus 7 primitive ($15), gravel pads; composting toilets, no dump station; online reservations. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: gafreshwatercamping.com live, Firefly online reservations (Nightly RV Site); 10 W/E sites $27 + 7 primitive $15 (campendium/exploregeorgia listings agree); Google 4.6 over 77; USACE Thurmond Lake land like sister park Hester's Ferry (4609) - federal, no price gate
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 33.66575,-82.44085: loop roads on a peninsula with Thurmond Lake on three sides, but sites are under continuous canopy; no pad confirmable at the shoreline - not waterfront (default down; candidate for a per-site upgrade like Hester's Ferry)

name: War Hill Park Campground
note: Dawson County park on a Lake Lanier peninsula: 14 primitive campsites (no hookups, no dump station) with a bathhouse (restrooms, hot showers), beach, boat ramps; open Mar 1 - Oct 31, $25/night, online reservations only. Max RV ~30 ft. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Dawson County Lake Parks page: '14 primitive campsites', 'nightly rate for camping is $25', online reservations; campendium lists max RV 30 ft (longest reported 22 ft); Google 4.5 over 404; county-run - local, no price gate
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 440 m frame, leaf-off) at 34.33206,-83.96362: campground road runs south along the west shore of the peninsula ~40-60 m from the water under deciduous woods; no pad confirmable at the shoreline - not waterfront (default down; a review says swimming from the site, so a lakefront upgrade candidate)

name: Coleman Lake Campground
note: Family-owned campground at Coleman Lake near Midville, in open fields above the Ogeechee River; full-hookup 30/50A sites, bathhouse, laundry, boat ramp. 2026 full hookup from $35/night ($210/week); long-term sites too. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: colemanlakecampground.com live with rates ('Full Hookup RV Sites starting at $35/night'); review on site 'stayed for one night passing through'; unrated default-$ park, published rate <= $50 passes; Google 4.6 over 38
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 32.8232,-82.2772: RVs scattered in an open field; the Ogeechee River runs ~100-150 m north behind a continuous tree belt - not waterfront
